name: Shelly Wave Door/Window LR
summary: Z-Wave LR/mesh battery door/window sensor with open/close, tilt and lux; needs a Z-Wave hub.

requires: Z-Wave controller (LR-capable for Long Range mode)

extra.lr_range: up to 80 m indoors / 1000 m outdoors
extra.compat_table: homee Gen5 and SmartThings sensors marked not working; Vera/Cozify TBD

gotchas: Requires a Z-Wave controller; Long Range mode needs an LR-capable controller
Gateway compatibility table marks SmartThings and homee Gen5 as not working for its sensors
~2-year CR2032 life vs 5 years on Shelly BLU Door/Window ZB
Battery node — never repeats the mesh
best_for: Z-Wave LR homes needing door/window + tilt sensing at long range from the hub
